answer: Stop sybils with a mesa violet tide: an agent stakes a bond for one mesa tide. Each cycle it marks a violet tide line on the mesa and files its reading; verifiers match the violet line to the tide gauge, voiding a mesa whose line is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 mesas at 16x: each tide fits one mesa and one violet line, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents mark once and keep rights.
